subject: Post-demo: security triage, notification windows & evidence request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@echolabs.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T17:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: security triage & evidence request

Hi Samira — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and next steps so your security team has what it needs to progress internal approval: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance posture
- Can you confirm which framework(s) Echolabs is currently certified against (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, both, neither)? If SOC 2, please confirm the coverage dates and whether the report covers production access and third-party hosting (we'll need the auditor letter or redacted report).

2) Regulatory scope
- Do you need HIPAA-specific assurances (BAA) or is GDPR data residency/processing the primary concern? Please list any PHI or regulated data classes you anticipate sending to Redwood.

3) Incident response & breach notification windows
- We shared high-level timelines on the call. We typically provide: detection/triage summary within 24 hours, initial notification within 72 hours for GDPR customers, and a fuller post-incident report within 30 days. If you have internal legal timelines stricter than these, tell us.

4) Evidence and artifacts request (we attached a short SOC 2 summary to speed review)
- SOC 2 report or auditor letter (redacted ok)
- Copy of incident response runbook excerpt showing notification owners and escalation paths
- BCP/DR summary (RTO/RPO targets)

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), notification-timeline-template.xlsx (blank template)

Next steps: could you confirm by EOD Tuesday 12/02 whether you can provide the SOC 2 letter + a sample IR runbook excerpt? If the SOC 2 isn't available, we can start with our security questionnaire (link in my next email) and a conversation between our security leads.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@echolabs.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Echolabs Security Team <security@echolabs.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security triage & evidence request

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- Echolabs does not currently have a SOC 2 Type II; we completed a Type I in 2025 and are in-scope for a Type II assessment in Q2 2027.
- GDPR is the main concern for this project; we will need documentation that describes data flows, subprocessors, and your planned notification commitments. HIPAA is not required for this workload.

We can provide an excerpt of our IR runbook and BCP statement, but we need to understand what Redwood expects for initial notification content. Is a short summary of affected services + contact owner acceptable within the 72-hour window? Also — do you have a vendor security questionnaire we should complete in parallel (we'd prefer a single intake form rather than multiple documents).

Samira Patel
Head of Security Operations, Echolabs Inc.
samira.patel@echolabs.io

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@echolabs.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security triage & evidence request

Samira — great, thanks for the transparency. Short answers and an attached template to make this lightweight.

1) Initial notification content (acceptable for us):
- Incident timestamp (UTC)
- Services/components impacted (short list)
- Whether customer data was accessed/exfiltrated (yes/no/unknown)
- POC for escalation (name/email/phone)

We agree that a short summary inside 72 hours is appropriate for GDPR-triggered notifications. For US customers with contractual 60-day windows we align timeline accordingly — but you said HIPAA not required so stick with GDPR baseline.

2) SOC status next steps
- Since you have Type I only, please provide that report and the planned timeline for Type II (Q2 2027). We'll record the Type I and flag Type II as a follow-up deliverable in our vendor intake.

3) Vendor intake / questionnaire
- Attaching a one-page vendor security questionnaire (link below) that covers the essentials to avoid redundant asks. If you can complete it within 10 business days that would keep the procurement timeline moving.

4) Evidence we need now (to attach to the intake):
- IR runbook excerpt (showing notification owners & escalation steps) — a redacted PDF/txt excerpt is fine.
- BCP/DR summary with RTO/RPO targets.
- Point to your subprocessor list or confirm none.

Attachments: notification-timeline-template.xlsx (filled example), ir-runbook-excerpt.txt (redacted sample).
Vendor intake form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_vendor_questionnaire
HubSpot link: https://hubspot.com/contacts/record/HL-78234

Can you confirm a target date to return the questionnaire + artifacts? If 12/13 works we'll be able to align legal and procurement to present terms to your team the week of 12/15.

Best — Jordan

Subject: Internal: Echolabs intake — SOC1/TypeI + IR artifacts requested (prep for legal)

Team — forwarding the thread and next steps. Action items: 

- Neha: pull the redacted SOC 2 Type II letter & SOC 2 summary we use for vendor intake. If we only have the auditor letter and not the full report, send the letter and the SOC summary PDF (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) used for pre-sales. Due: 12/01 EOD.

- Rishi: prepare a short IR runbook excerpt (ir-runbook-excerpt.txt) showing our detection -> notification -> legal/PR escalation path and include named owners/roles (not private contact cards). Attach to the vendor intake package. Due: 12/01 noon.

- Grace: open HubSpot HL-78234 and add Echolabs as "security pending" with expected return date 12/13. Coordinate with Legal to make sure the BAA is not required for this deal.

Keep this tight — Samira indicated they can return the questionnaire & artifacts in ~10 business days if we provide a single intake form. I want procurement to be ready to push terms the week of 12/15.

Thanks — Jordan
